committees.name: DNC SERVICES CORP / DEMOCRATIC NATIONAL COMMITTEE
committees.speaker: committee

source.excerpt: The DNC performs many roles within Democratic politics, the most important of which is working to elect Democrats to all levels of government, from school board to the Oval Office.

The DCCC is the official campaign arm of the Democrats in the House of Representatives and the only political committee in the country whose principal mission is to support Democratic House candidates every step of the way.
The Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee is the only committee solely dedicated to electing a Democratic Senate.

source.source_name: Rules of the Republican Party, Rule No. 1(a)
source.excerpt: The Republican National Committee shall have the general management of the Republican Party, based upon the rules adopted by the Republican National Convention.
The National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC) is a political committee devoted to increasing the number of Republicans in the U.S. House of Representatives.

The NRSC (National Republican Senatorial Committee) is the only national organization solely devoted to strengthening the Republican Senate Majority and electing Republicans to the United States Senate.
